column7: 2026-11-06: JSONStorage sort_keys=True default was tried and backed out (not in release). json.dumps(sort_keys=True) raises TypeError on mixed int/str dict keys, e.g. ingest docs {'hits': {200: 1520, 'other': 3}}. Preferred redo: stringify keys then sort in JSONStorage.write, keep sort_keys=False opt-out, add test with that doc shape. User will revisit after the release.

2026-11-06: Implemented sort_keys=True default in JSONStorage via _stringify_keys (my choice: stringify keys following json's rules, then sort); sort_keys=False opts out. Tests added in tests/test_storages.py incl. mixed int/str keys. Known edge: int key 1 and str key '1' in the same dict collapse to one entry when sorting.
